finding.text: Requirement 1 is short one piece: seat (h)'s table lists `Store.address()` (`core/Item/Store.js:240`, replacement "structured `from` on `move`"), and it has no `DEPRECATED (` mark; the census prints 13 marks on 11 symbols and none is `Store.address`. Add the one line, or write in the landing why it was skipped.

Nothing in this task folder records requirement 5's proof or the build's progress: `session.jsonl` holds only the assign line, a commit stamp and the shots line, and there is no landing, test log or smoke result. A fresh agent can't tell from the folder that tests were run. I ran them in the worktree and they pass (Item 28 assertions, List 19, Task 66/66, Session snapshot PASS, persistence 82 checks, `Deprecated.test.mjs` 6 asserts). Write those results, and the smoke result, into the landing.

Two table rows have no mark, and the reason is sound but not written anywhere: the config key `children:` and `{"file":x}` both have an undecided replacement. Say in the landing that they were left on purpose.

Neither guide the `List#each`/`List#children` and `Task#finish` marks point at mentions those names. `core/List/readme.md` never names the old aliases. `core/Task/readme.md:124` does say "`finish()` is an alias", so that one is fine. One line in the List readme would close it.

The evidence I was given doesn't match this build. `review/diff.patch` is 5,502 lines against michael/dev, so it also contains builds A to C (ClassDoc, watch/, DefaultView). The real build G diff is `git diff integration/data-shapes...worktree/deprecate`: 58 files, +368/−2. The shots are of `monorepo.localhost` (the main tree), not the worktree, and of pages build G doesn't change. Fix this in `Server/review.mjs` (diff base and shot host for a branch made off an integration branch), not in this build.
